description: Search Threads for keywords and return one flat row per post that contains the keyword: text, author, publish date, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, and the post link, plus one free summary row per keyword. By default a post is kept only when the keyword's words are in its text next to each other; a post found by several keywords is returned once. Threads shows a visitor who is not logged in about 20 to 25 posts per search. Reads the public Threads search page; no login or key. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per post row.

include_replies.description: Return matching replies too. Default true.

keywords.description: Words or phrases to search Threads for, up to 50.

match_mode.description: phrase keeps a post when the keyword's words are next to each other in its text; all_words when every word is somewhere; off keeps every result. Default phrase.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

min_likes.description: Set aside posts with fewer likes.

only_new.description: Skip posts an earlier run returned (free). Default false.

proxy_mode.description: auto uses the Apify proxy pool with residential as the fallback; residential uses residential addresses for every search. Does not change the price. Default auto.

since_days.description: Set aside posts older than this many days.

state_key.description: Optional name for the only new posts memory.

name: search_threads_posts
title: Search Threads posts by keyword
